said.t: The statement called on Israel to respond to appeals from the international community and the Board of Peace and immediately fulfill its obligations under the Sharm El-Sheikh Agreement, Trump's Comprehensive Plan and UN Security Council Resolution 2803 (2025).

Foreign ministers from 18 countries, including Türkiye, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Pakistan, strongly condemned an Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, Gaza, saying it violated international humanitarian law and endangered patients and medical workers.

14, the ministers said the attack, which caused casualties among patients and health care personnel, violated the special protections afforded to medical facilities and their workers under international humanitarian law.

The ministers urged Israel to respond to appeals from the international community and the Board of Peace by immediately and fully implementing its obligations under the Sharm El-Sheikh Agreement, Trump's Comprehensive Plan and United Nations Security Council Resolution 2803, adopted in 2025.

The deadliest single strike since Israel’s elections last month hit the surgery ward of Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis early on Thursday, killing at least six Palestinians, including a 13-year-old boy, and wounding nearly 30 others.
